mapper.sql: tdm13_task_relate_duty_id AS task_relate_duty_id , tdm13_task_id AS task_id , tdm13_task_relate_detail_id AS task_relate_detail_id , tdm13_content AS content , tdm13_seq AS seq , tdm13_use_yn AS use_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tdm13_task_relate_duty INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm10_task_id = tdm13_task_id INNER JOIN tdm14_task_type ON tdm10_company_id = tdm14_company_id AND tdm14_task_type_cd = tdm10_task_type_cd WHERE tdm13_task_relate_detail_id = #{taskRelateDetailId} AND tdm10_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY tdm13_seq
SELECT tdm10_company_id FROM tdm12_task_relate_detail INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm10_task_id = tdm12_task_id WHERE tdm12_task_relate_detail_id = #{taskRelateDetailId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm13_task_relate_duty ( tdm13_task_relate_duty_id, tdm13_task_id, tdm13_task_relate_detail_id, tdm13_content, tdm13_seq, tdm13_use_yn, tdm13_upd_nm, tdm13_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{dutyId}, #{row.taskId}, #{row.taskRelateDetailId}, #{row.content}, #{row.seq}, #{row.useYn}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
